opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 0.6% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are context only; MarketLens does not treat headline wording as a validated directional signal.

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
Over the last 20 trading days, QQQ has outperformed SPY by about 3.9 percentage points.
Recent headlines contain potential catalyst themes: earnings/guidance, product/operations. Review the underlying headlines rather than treating this as a sentiment score.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 0.8% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.

Over the last 20 trading days, INTC has outperformed SPY by about 39.6 percentage points.
Recent headlines contain potential catalyst themes: earnings/guidance. Review the underlying headlines rather than treating this as a sentiment score.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
Over the last 20 trading days, META has outperformed SPY by about 30.1 percentage points.
Recent headlines contain potential catalyst themes: product/operations. Review the underlying headlines rather than treating this as a sentiment score.
Recent earnings dates in the available history produced an average absolute next-session move of about 2.0%.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 4.6% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are context only; MarketLens does not treat headline wording as a validated directional signal.

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
Over the last 20 trading days, AMD has outperformed SPY by about 27.8 percentage points.
Recent headlines contain potential catalyst themes: analyst activity. Review the underlying headlines rather than treating this as a sentiment score.
Recent earnings dates in the available history produced an average absolute next-session move of about 2.3%.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 3.0% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

readiness.note: Only forward paper trades from the current strategy using real-time entry data count. Passing these checks does not guarantee future profitability or authorize real-money trading.

forward_validation.note: Reference profit frequency and expected payoff come from evidence captured before entry. Forward realized outcomes are the primary validation record.

attribution.note: Attribution uses current-strategy, real-time-source trades and facts captured at entry. Small samples should not be treated as evidence of a durable edge.

learning.note: Learning uses only current-strategy trades entered from real-time data. It remains disabled until the minimum forward sample is reached; eligible adjustments are capped at ±10% and never rewrite prior decisions.
